definition.AMBIGUOUS_NO_RECEIPT: A component without a Goods Receipt link: its origin cannot be proven, so nothing is adjusted.
definition.AMBIGUOUS_TIRE: A tire installation with no receipt link and no covering issue: whether the ledger held the unit cannot be proven. Never adjusted automatically.
definition.CORRECTED_BY_RECONCILIATION: Corrected earlier through an approved adjustment; shown for the record.
definition.COVERED_BY_WO_ISSUE: A Work Order part issue already took a unit out of stock: nothing to correct, never deducted again.
definition.NOT_WAREHOUSE_ORIGIN: A tire registered directly on a vehicle (initial registration): it was never warehouse stock.
definition.PROVABLE_UNDEDUCTED: The unit came from a posted Goods Receipt, no issued Work Order line covers it and no later opname settled it. Only this class can be adjusted.
definition.RESOLVED_BY_OPNAME: A posted stock opname of this warehouse and product is later than the installation: the physical count already settled the quantity. No adjustment is allowed.

help.applyConfirm: Book one stock issue for unit {{serial}} now? It is dated today, references the old installation and cannot be applied twice.
help.makerCannotApprove: You proposed this: another person must decide.
help.noStockMovesYet: Stock does not change when you propose or approve. Only applying an approved adjustment books one issue, dated now.
help.opnameProves: A stock opname proves the physical quantity at that time, not why the ledger differed. It is evidence for review, not a historical cause.
help.page: Serialized units installed before installations settled with the stock ledger may still be counted as stock. Nothing is changed here until an adjustment is proposed, approved by a second person and applied; the original history is never edited.
help.proposeSummary: Unit {{serial}}, installed {{date}}, never left the warehouse ledger. Proposing sends it for approval by a second person.
help.tireNotAdjusted: Tires without a Goods Receipt link are never adjusted automatically and no receipt is guessed. Resolve them with a physical stock opname per warehouse.

opname.stale: system snapshot was stale when posted
